body.x: Altec Lancing(www.alteclansing.com), a company with a mission of connecting people to sound through innovative speaker designs, introduced "BoomJacket" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.This floating speaker features high-quality sound, voice confirmation, caller ID, and an onboard microphone for clear, hands-free communication. The rugged jacket is waterproof, dustproof, and shockproof. It boasts 16 hours of battery life and also can provide power to smartphones and other devices using USB cable.
